metadata.description:
This protocol is for setting up a 
     logaritmic serial dilution of a single reagent for cell-free expression. 
     In total 7 concentrations of the reagent are tested in technical triplicates
     including an internal control without DNA and the highest concentration.
metadata.author: Karen Therkelsen (s173684@dtu.dk)
